traits.leaf_division.note: Small (1913), genus Trifolium: annual or perennial herbs with erect or creeping stems; leaves alternate, divided into three leaflets from one point (digitately), rarely five to seven; leaflets entire or toothed; flowers in short or long racemes, often in heads.

traits.division_pattern.note: Small (1913), genus Trifolium: the leaflets spread from one point (digitately three-foliolate), rarely five to seven.
